messages:
mia: heads up — noticed a reproducible accuracy blip on the new quant profile during canary on dedicated-ssd-2.
kevin: which model / quant variant?
mia: llama-70b / AWQ-ish group-act quant run. we rolled group_size=32 -> 48 and enabled per_channel_act=true in the canary config.
kevin: oof. numbers?
mia: eval on our heldout suite: EM dropped 2.8%, F1 down 3.1% vs baseline GPTQ-INT8. latency fine, but quality loss is consistent across seeds.
sara: did you warm-start KV cache or cold-start? any difference?
mia: cold-start tests show larger delta. warmstarted runs (cached prefixes) shrink the gap to ~1.1% EM loss.
juan: might be act quant causing activation clamping on earlier layers. can you share the exact runtime flags?
mia: paste config snippet:
```
quant_profile: awq_custom_v3
group_size: 48
act_quant: true
per_channel_act: true
clip_threshold: 6.0
prefix_cache: disabled
```
kevin: thanks. quick probe: i ran a trimmed eval with per_channel_act=false and group_size=48 — EM delta fell to 0.7%.
sara: so per_channel_act is the suspicious knob. any logs showing NaNs or out-of-range activations?
mia: no NaNs, but activation histograms show heavier tails in early layers during generation. attached a tiny ascii summary in the thread.
ci-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T18:02:34Z started for canary/awq-v3 -> dedicated-ssd-2
juan: hypothesis: per_channel quant scaling + larger group blends distributions causing quantization step mismatch for rare tokens. also prefix_cache off means more cold tokens hit quant mapping.
nora: propose two-step: 1) rollback per_channel_act=true -> false in canary, 2) run fine-grained bisect over group_size {16,24,32,40,48} with 3 seeds each, compare to GPTQ baseline.
kevin: volunteering to run bisect on juice-quant queue. will script it: small runner that toggles per_channel and group_size, collects EM/F1 and trace.
mia: thanks. please keep canary pinned to stable profile for user traffic. i'll open a short incident note and tag CS.
sara: also try increasing clip_threshold to 8.0 in one arm. if tails are clipping, raising threshold might help.
kevin: starting jobs now. i'll post results as they finish. ETA ~2.5h for full grid on small eval.
mia: if bisect reproduces the drop only when both per_channel=true and group_size>=40, we'll mark as blocker for rollout and disable that combination.
juan: add a stress test that toggles prefix_cache on/off — we need to see impact on cold-start heavy workloads.
kevin: quick partial results (first batch): group_size=16/24/32 w/ per_channel=false -> EM delta <=0.6%. group_size=40/48 w/ per_channel=true -> EM delta ~2.5-3.0%. attaching short log excerpt:
```
[run: gs=48 pc=true] EM: 68.2 -> baseline 71.3 (delta -3.1)
[run: gs=32 pc=false] EM: 70.8 -> delta -0.5
```
mia: solid repro. i'll block the rollout and update the canary config.
sara: follow-up: file a ticket to evaluate per-channel scaling algorithm (different centering / percentile heuristics). might be a mismatch in our calibration dataset.
mia: noted. opening ticket INF-quant-278.
kevin: logs and runner artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-quant/bisect/3412345678/
juan: thanks team. we'll retest after we try clip_threshold and a per-channel re-calibration pass.
mia: end of thread for now. :thumbsup:
